subject: LLM pilot — temporary pause requested by prospect

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Sara Raymond <sara@heliomed.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + demo — suggested times this week

Hi Sara,

Great speaking with you briefly on the phone — thanks for the context on the data pipelines and the latency budget. Marcus and I would love to walk through a focused 30‑minute demo tailored to your ingestion pattern and expected concurrency.

Would any of the following windows work for your team this week?
- Wed 04/01 11:00–11:30 PT
- Thu 04/02 10:00–10:30 PT
- Fri 04/03 14:00–14:30 PT

If none of those fit, happy to tee up a 20‑minute async summary and a short ROI sketch for your product lead. I attached a one‑pager on pricing so you have the economics handy.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0142
Attachments: redwood-pricing-1pager.pdf

From: Sara Raymond <sara@heliomed.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — suggested times this week

Hi Soojin —

Appreciate the quick follow up. I’m afraid we need to ask for a pause on scheduling for the near term. We just froze the Q2 roadmap to reallocate engineering capacity to a near‑term regulatory integration and two senior engineers are traveling next week for on‑site audits. Given that, the LLM/inference pilot is being deprioritized and pushed into the roadmap queue.

Can we revisit in late Q3? If helpful, I can share a short snapshot of our roadmap priorities — I’m attaching the internal timeline so you can see where things landed. Please keep us on your list but it’ll be low touch for a while.

Best,
Sara Raymond
Sr. Director, Product — HelioMed Inc.
sara@heliomed.com | +1 (617) 555‑2209
Attachments: heliomed-roadmap-snapshot.pdf

Date: 2027-04-01T13:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo — suggested times this week

Thanks for the update, Sara — totally understand and congrats on the upcoming audit (that always takes priority).

Two quick notes:
1) I’ll mark the opportunity as paused in HubSpot and add a short note about the roadmap freeze + travel.
2) If it helps, we can set a tentative touchpoint now (e.g., first week of Oct) and I’ll follow up with a short one‑pager on expected latency gains and a conservative cost estimate so you have something to evaluate internally.

Would you prefer a calendar placeholder (tentative) or for us to wait until you give the green light? Either works on our side.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
